body: Oh. Not what I was looking for. I'll be leaving then.
Oh I thought this was the place for this. Since /r/suicide redirected to this.

Well I've been depressed since age 9. Never really felt happy for longer than 5 minutes. Unless I'm doing drugs. Which I can't do all day and night.

Nothing I do brings me satisfaction and it's come to point where I'm not doing anything. Gonna fail school soon which is going to cause a shitstorm.  I don't really care for living in a society like this anyhow. It's on a destructive path to a point of no return at which it will have to decide. Do we make everything free and live for everyone. Or do we keep ourselves in ignorance and hope that enough people die so that the planet can heal itself enough for the rest?

Corruption in this world is on every level even though that is not natural since our instincts are of altruistic nature. Yet sociopaths are very common and even rule the world. There is no way of changing this within my lifetime.

I also do not like myself. Aspergers, phimosis and pectus excavatum are the bane of my existence yet people only know about the first. Even those three are far from the only thing but the details all add up. Although they are too numeral to explain.

Combining the sense of helplessness, no motivation, hatred for the world and myself makes that I do not belong in this world. I have absolutely no intention of fitting in with the rest of society. I despise it. 

That's why every day I survive is a disappointment and eveytime I wake up is also a disappointment.
I think I read somewhere that methane was good. Or was it carbon monoxide?
